If one party is of a larger @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Командование}

Умение применять завуалированные или недвусмысленные угрозы (физической расправой или иными ужасными карами), чтобы заставить цель сделать или рассказать что-либо. Жертва противостоит запугиванию при помощи @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Дисциплина (Самообладание)}. Если одна сторона такого разговора превосходит другую @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{размером}, то она получает преимущество в проверке.

name: Elongated Bulk
desc: When the Acynadi Gamma-7 Charges, its target must make a Challenging (+0) Reflexes (Balance) Test to avoid being knocked Prone.

name: Slippery Burrower
desc: When in shallow pools of liquid or atop soft earth, the Acynadi Gamme-7 can make a Hide Action to burrow out of sight. It can also do this as a free action immediately after making the Disengage Action.

name: Wall Climber
desc: The Acynadi Delta-5 can climb most surfaces without making a Test. When it attacks or defends against a target from above, it gains Advantage.

name: Might
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Advanced capacity for moving greater weight, breaking physical objects, and enduring heavy loads. In appropriate circumstances, an Athletics (Might) Test can be used in place of a Presence (Intimidation) Test to achieve similar aims.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Advanced capacity for moving greater weight, breaking physical objects, and enduring heavy loads. In appropriate circumstances, an Athletics (Might) Test can be used in place of a Presence (Intimidation) Test to achieve similar aims.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Атлетика}

Эта специализация позволяет поднимать больший вес, ломать предметы и подолгу нести груз. В уместных обстоятельствах Атлетика (Мощь) может применяться вместо Командования (Запугивание).

name: Endurance
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Стойкость}

Умение подолгу не спать и справляться с усталостью.

name: Pain
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Increased capability for resisting torture and doing one’s duty despite injuries, due to extensive training in withstanding pain.

Развитая способность переносить пытки и исполнять свой долг, несмотря на ранения, развитая болезненными упражнениями.

desc:

Experience in the brutal art of pugilism. Covers everything from fighting with bare hands or brass knuckles, through to inflicting devastating blows with a mighty @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Tm38HWpxtnkcrmKl]{Power Fist}.

name: Forbidden
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#linguistics-(int)]{Linguistics}

Those possessed of this skill understand a language or form of communication that is either highly restricted or prohibited within the Imperium. With few exceptions, it is considered heretical to know the languages of aliens; however, the Sisters of the Orders Dialogus are frequently granted special dispensation from the Adeptus Ministorum to learn such in pursuit of their duties. Some xenos languages, such as the Kroot’s, are unpronounceable by a Human tongue without augmentation. While some languages are considered too profane to speak, others are too holy for common knowledge. The Lingua-technis of the Adeptus Mechanicus is a forbidden language that few outside their order have ever learned, in part, because it is based on binary machine code that all but the most gifted individuals require cybernetic implants to speak. Thoughtmark, the form of sign language used by the Sisters of Silence, is also known to very few outsiders. Each Forbidden Language requires taking a corresponding @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Lbm6mRMiqSGHq9GD]{Forbidden Knowledge} Talent in order to learn it.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#psychic-mastery-(wil)]{Psychic Mastery}

Many other Psychic Disciplines exist throughout the galaxy, more secretive or forbidden that even the abhorred practices of the Imperium's sanctioned psykers. Some of these will be explored in future supplements, and likely require a corresponding @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Lbm6mRMiqSGHq9GD]{Forbidden Knowledge} Talent in order to learn.
ru:

В галактике существуют и иные психические дисциплины — тайные или даже запретные для имперских санкционированных псайкеров. Некоторые появятся в будущих дополнениях, а чтобы их изучить, скорее всего, потребуется соответствующий талант @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Lbm6mRMiqSGHq9GD]{Запретные тайны}.

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Aptitude in a variety of techniques designed to elicit answers out of a subject. A skilled interrogator implies pressure in many ways, subtle and not, in order to discover as much information as they can, even when a subject is cooperative. Interrogation is not physical torture, though undergoing a long interrogation may certainly feel agonising. Interrogation is opposed by the target's @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)} or @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.hu6z7RnzzKS830Av]{Endurance (Pain)}.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Aptitude in a variety of techniques designed to elicit answers out of a subject. A skilled interrogator implies pressure in many ways, subtle and not, in order to discover as much information as they can, even when a subject is cooperative. Interrogation is opposed by the target's @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)} or @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.hu6z7RnzzKS830Av]{Endurance (Pain)}.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Командование}

Умение применять множество методов получать ответы. Умелый дознаватель может оказывать давление самыми разными приёмами — скрытными и явными, — чтобы вытянуть сведения из допрашиваемого, даже если тот готов сотрудничать. Речь не о пытках, хотя долгий допрос может быть очень выматывающим. Броскам дознавателя цель противопоставляет @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Дисциплина (Самообладание)} или @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.hu6z7RnzzKS830Av]{Стойкость (Боль)}.

desc:

Applying pressure through threats, subtle or blatant, that physical chastisement and other dire fates await those that fail to do as they are told or confess all they know. Intimidation is often opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)}. If one party is of a larger @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.

Жертва противостоит запугиванию при помощи @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Дисциплина (Самообладание)}. Если одна сторона такого разговора превосходит другую @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{размером}, то она получает преимущество в проверке.

name: Call for Backup
desc: As an Action, a Vigilite can call for backup. All Macharian Vigilites in a 1 mile radius respond in [[/r 1d10]] Rounds (or minutes if out of combat).
candEn: As an Action, an Arbitrator can call for backup. This call is heard by all Enforcers in a 1 mile radius. Backup usually arrives in [[/r 1d10]] Rounds (or minutes if out of combat), but may be shorter or longer depending on distance.
ru: Потратив действие, арбитр может вызвать подкрепление. Его могут услышать силовики в радиусе одной мили. Обычно подкрепление прибывает через [[/r 1d10]] раундов (или минут, если сейчас не идёт бой), но это время может измениться в зависимости от расстояния.

name: Incarceratus
desc: When a Vigilite is Grappling an individual they can Manacle them as a Free Action
candEn: When an Arbitrator is Grappling an individual they can Manacle them as a Free Action.
ru: Когда арбитр берёт противника в захват, он может защёлкнуть на том оковы за свободное действие.

name: Ambusher
desc: Heldrax can attempt to make a Stealth Test as part of his Movement if the Zone he is in has Cover.
candEn: The Imperial Bounty Hunter can attempt to make a Stealth Test as part of their Movement if the Zone they are in has Cover.
ru: Охотник за головами может предпринять проверку Скрытности в ходе своего движения, если у зоны, в которой он находится, есть свойство Укрытие.

name: Cameleoline Training
desc: Heldrax has Advantage on Stealth Tests if he does not move that turn.

name: Stalker's Riposte
desc: If an enemy is wounded within Short Range of Heldrax he can use his Reaction to order a Heldrax’s Stalkers member within hearing to make an immediate Action against that target (this uses the character’s Reaction).

name: True Faith
desc: Caul has 1 point of Fate.
candEn: The Devout has 1 point of Fate.
ru: Праведник получает одно очко судьбы.

name: Burn the Witch
desc: When a psyker within Short Range of Caul Manifests a power, Caul may use his Reaction to make an immediate @UUID[.Pw1HijVPDKGXJYlM]{Hand Flamer} attack on the zone that psyker is in.

name: Sanctioned Psyker
desc: Caul has a Warp Threshold equal to double his Willpower bonus.
candEn: The Sanctioned Psyker has a Warp Threshold equal to double their Willpower bonus (this is included).
ru: Порог санкционата равен удвоенному бонусу его Силы воли. Это уже учтено в профиле.

desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Studied in the use and repair of different types of augmetic devices. Most augmetics are mechanical or electrical augmetic substitutes for Human biological parts, many with enhanced capacities, though some offer entirely new capabilities. Augmetics requires at least 1 Advance in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Medicae} Skill.

Умение применять и чинить разные типы имплантатов. Зачастую аугметика — это механические и электрические протезы, что заменяют части тела, иногда превосходя органические «оригиналы», а иногда открывая совершенно новые возможности. Чтобы приобрести эту специализацию, персонаж должен иметь хотя бы одно улучшение @UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Медики}.

name: Engineering
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of the construction, use, and restoration of technological and mechanical devices. Encompasses the crafting of such items, as well as weapons and explosives. Within the Imperium, the Adeptus Mechanicus considers this entire branch of knowledge to be their exclusive right and will punish those who use it, or even study it, without their sanction. Notably, an individual that knows only how to assemble or repair a device by rote need not have this Specialisation.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Notably, an individual that knows only how to assemble or repair a device by rote need not have this Specialisation.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Техника}

Знания о конструкции, применении и ремонте технологических и механических устройств. Эта специализация позволяет и конструировать такие предметы, а также оружие и взрывчатку. В Империуме Адептус Механикус считают эту область знания исключительно своей епархией и карают самоучек. Помните, впрочем, что для того, чтобы собрать или починить устройство, пользуясь заученными ритуалами, эта специализация не требуется.

name: Augmetic Heart
desc: As an Action, the Tech-Priest makes a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test. If they are successful, they remove a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#bleeding]{Bleeding} Condition from themself.
candEn: As an Action, the Tech-Priest makes a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test. If they are successful, they remove a @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#bleeding]{Bleeding} Condition from themself.
ru: Потратив действие, техножрец проходит среднюю (+0) проверку Стойкости. В случае успеха он снимает с себя состояние @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#bleeding]{Кровотечение}.

name: Utility Mechadendrite
desc: Functions as a Combi-tool and a melee weapon.
ru: Служит комбиинструментом и холодным оружием.

name: Utility Mechadendrite
desc:
These snake-like metal devices are affixed to the chest, back, or shoulders and act as additional manipulators. They are only found among adepts of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.1oKZw1hTM7Gx5cqB]{Adeptus Mechanicus}, and extend roughly 2 metres in length. Each is fitted with its own special mechanisms. Using any Mechadendrite requires an Action.

Each Mechadendrite counts as a separate augmentation towards the maximum number a character can possess. If a character with Mechadendrites would suffer a Critical Wound to the Body location, roll a d10. If the result is less than the number of functioning Mechadendrites the character has installed, one of those is damaged instead. Damaged Mechadendrites cannot be used until they are repaired.

  • Utility: These are fitted with several devices for repairing and renovating machines, and are the most common form of Mechadendrite. They count as a Standard Quality @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.xQ2vhqZTWMBZ3Jxi]{Combi-Tool}, granting +2 SL to Tech Tests, and can be used in melee combat as an @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.CrbE669FitnwNPZX]{Improvised Melee Weapon (One-handed)}.
candEn:

  • Utility: These are fitted with several devices for repairing and renovating machines, and are the most common form of Mechadendrite. ru:
Эти змееподобные, почти двухметровые металлические «руки» крепятся на груди, спине или плечах хозяина и служат ему дополнительными конечностями. Каждый оснащён специальными приспособлениями и при подсчёте предельного количества имплантатов, что может поставить себе персонаж, считается отдельной единицей аугметики. Механодендриты встречаются только у членов Адептус Механикус.

Применение механодендрита требует действия. Если персонаж, имеющий механодендриты, получает критическую рану в торс, бросьте 1к10. Если выпадет число, меньшее количества установленных и работающих механодендритов, значит попадание повреждает механодендрит. Повреждённый механодендрит не будет работать, пока его не починят.

Это самый расхожий тип механодендрита — он оснащён инструментами для работы с машинами и считается комбиинструментом среднего качества, но приносит +2 успеха к проверкам Техники, а также может использоваться в ближнем бою как импровизированное одноручное оружие.

name: Stalwart
desc: Echo Team Troopers have Advantage on Tests to resist or end the Frightened Condition.
candEn: The Astra Militarum Trooper has Advantage on Tests to resist or end the @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#frightened]{Frightened} Condition.
ru: Солдат получает преимущество в проверках, предпринятых, чтобы сопротивляться состоянию @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#frightened]{Страх} или прекратить его воздействие.

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Applying pressure through threats, subtle or blatant, that physical chastisement and other dire fates await those that fail to do as they are told or confess all they know. Intimidation is often opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)}. If one party is of a larger @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.

@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Командование}

Умение применять завуалированные или недвусмысленные угрозы (физической расправой или иными ужасными карами), чтобы заставить цель сделать или рассказать что-либо. Жертва противостоит запугиванию при помощи @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Дисциплина (Самообладание)}. Если одна сторона такого разговора превосходит другую @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{размером}, то она получает преимущество в проверке.

name: Bestial Rage
desc: When a Mutated Beastman makes a successful attack or is wounded, he gains +2 SL on his next attack.

name: Bullish Charge
desc: When a Mutated Beastman Charges, he does not gain Disadvantage on Melee and Reflexes Tests.

name: Mutation
desc:
For each Mutated Beastman encountered, roll [[/r 1d10]] to determine, or choose its mutation:

1-4: Extra Eye — The Mutated Beastman has grown extra eyes on its head or body. They have Advantage on Awareness (Sight) Tests.

5-7: Extra Limb — The Mutated Beastman has an extra limb. They may make an additional Hoof Strike or Unarmed attack during their turn.

8-0: Grasping Tentacle — The Mutated Beastman has grown a Tentacle. Its Unarmed attacks gain the Reach and Inflict (Restrained) Traits.

name: One-handed
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.

Владение мечами, топорами, булавами и другим холодным оружием, что можно удерживать одной рукой.

name: Pistols
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#ranged-(bs)]{Ranged}

Extensive training in the use of handguns, such as laspistols, bolt pistols, autopistols, stub revolvers, and similar firearms.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#ranged-(bs)]{Ranged}

Extensive training in the use of handguns, such as laspistols, bolt pistols, autopistols, stub revolvers, and similar firearms.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#ranged-(bs)]{Стрельба}

Обширная подготовка по применению лазпистолетов, болт-пистолетов, стаб-револьверов, автопистолетов и им подобного оружия.

name: Dodge
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#reflexes-(ag)]{Reflexes}

Capacity for avoiding injury or accident through quick movements designed to sidestep the danger. Can be used to defend yourself in combat against melee and ranged attacks. While the unaugmented cannot directly dodge bullets, they can avoid being shot by swiftly removing themselves from the line of fire.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#reflexes-(ag)]{Reflexes}

Capacity for avoiding injury or accident through quick movements designed to sidestep the danger. Can be used to defend yourself in combat against melee and ranged attacks. While the unaugmented cannot directly dodge bullets, they can avoid being shot by swiftly removing themselves from the line of fire.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#reflexes-(ag)]{Рефлексы}

Умение избегать ранений и несчастных случаев, уворачиваясь от опасностей. Эту специализацию можно применять, чтобы защищаться от стрелковых атак и атак в ближнем бою. Конечно, неаугментированный человек не сумеет ускользнуть от пули, но может быстро убраться с линии огня.

name: Bio-Meltdown
desc: Should Eversor Interitas perish, deeply embedded genetic kill codes trigger, driving what remains of his enhanced metabolism into overdrive. The resulting explosion threatens all those in Immediate Range, who must make a Difficult (−10) Reflexes (Dodge) Test or suffer [[/r 2d10]] damage to a random hit location.

name: Inhuman Physiology
desc: A mixture of bio-modification and auto-injected combat drugs such as Frenzon make Eversor Interitas immune to the Fatigued, Frightened, and Stunned Conditions. He also gains Advantage on any Test to resist mind-altering psychic powers and substances.

name: Lightning Reflexes
desc: The Eversor’s reflexes have been enhanced far beyond Human limits. He may dodge any ranged attack, even ones he would seem to be unaware of.

name: Lethal Toxins
desc: An Eversor’s toxins are short-lived but particularly lethal. A Poisoned Condition inflicted by an Eversor’s weaponry has a duration of [[/r 1d5]][17:52]rounds, after which time the character must pass a  Challenging (+0) Fortitude (Poison) Test or die.

name: Overkill Protocols
desc: Eversor Interitas is inhumanly fast, and acts twice each round — once on its own initiative, and once again at the end of the initiative order. Additionally, any time he inflicts a Critical Wound, he may immediately make another attack.

name: Sentinel Array
desc: The Eversor cannot be Surprised, and gains Advantage on all Awareness Tests.

name: Might
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Advanced capacity for moving greater weight, breaking physical objects, and enduring heavy loads. In appropriate circumstances, an Athletics (Might) Test can be used in place of a Presence (Intimidation) Test to achieve similar aims.

Эта специализация позволяет поднимать больший вес, ломать предметы и подолгу нести груз. В уместных обстоятельствах Атлетика (Мощь) может применяться вместо Командования (Запугивание).

name: Endurance
desc:

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Умение подолгу не спать и справляться с усталостью.

name: Pain
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Increased capability for resisting torture and doing one’s duty despite injuries, due to extensive training in withstanding pain.
candEn:

Развитая способность переносить пытки и исполнять свой долг, несмотря на ранения, развитая болезненными упражнениями.

name: Bullish Charge
desc: When Mesk Charges, he does not gain Disadvantage on Melee and Reflexes Tests.

name: Bestial Rage
desc: When Mesk makes a successful attack or is wounded, he gains +1 SL on his next attack.

name: Herdcrafted Cleaver
desc: Mesk only has access to this weapon if he can recover one or is given one by the characters.

name: Brawling
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Experience in the brutal art of pugilism. Covers everything from fighting with bare hands or brass knuckles, through to inflicting devastating blows with a mighty @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Tm38HWpxtnkcrmKl]{Power Fist}.

Владение жестоким искусством драться голыми руками. Оно поможет расправляться с врагами при помощи рук, кастетов или даже могучих @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Tm38HWpxtnkcrmKl]{силовых кулаков}.

desc:

Better aptitude at swimming through liquids, typically water. Essential on some worlds with planet-spanning oceans, and almost unknown on others.

ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Атлетика}

Лучшая специализация для того, чтобы уверенно чувствовать себя в воде или иной жидкости. Необходима на мирах-океанах, совершенно не нужна в пустынях.

name: Climbing
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Practised ability to safely and efficiently traverse vertical surfaces. Frequently useful on both Feral and Hive Worlds. Valuable in combat if one has to scale the side of a servo-hauler to get the drop on a heretical demagogue.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Practised ability to safely and efficiently traverse vertical surfaces. Frequently useful on both Feral and Hive Worlds. Valuable in combat if one has to scale the side of a servo-hauler to get the drop on a heretical demagogue.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Атлетика}

Атлет оттачивает умение быстро и безопасно подниматься по вертикальным поверхностям — очень полезно на диких мирах и в ульях. Это ценная способность в бою, если вам нужно взобраться на верх сервогрузовика, чтобы сбросить вниз еретического демагога.

name: Touch
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#awareness-(per)]{Awareness}

Capacity to feel unusual vibrations which indicate the passage of subterranean vehicles and weapon systems. Trained to discern the origin of fabrics and unusual materials by feel. Useful for detecting pickpockets.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#awareness-(per)]{Awareness}

Capacity to feel unusual vibrations which indicate the passage of subterranean vehicles and weapon systems. Trained to discern the origin of fabrics and unusual materials by feel. Useful for detecting pickpockets.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#awareness-(per)]{Бдительность}

Умение воспринимать необычные вибрации, что могут говорить о движении подземных машин или огне орудий, а также способность наощупь распознавать ткани и необычные материалы. Полезно, чтобы поймать за руку карманника.

name: Surroundings
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Training in learning to continually read the surrounding environment, noting unusual mistakes in layout, furtive steps, concealed shapes, or ominous patterns of behaviour which indicate something is wrong.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Training in learning to continually read the surrounding environment, noting unusual mistakes in layout, furtive steps, concealed shapes, or ominous patterns of behaviour which indicate something is wrong.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Чутьё}

Такая подготовка позволяет «читать» окружение, подмечать всё необычное в обстановке, обращать внимание на тихие шаги, неясные фигуры или зловещее поведение.

name: Slippery Burrower
desc: When in shallow pools of liquid or atop soft earth, the Acynadi Delta-5 can make a Hide Action to burrow out of sight. It can also do this as a free action immediately after making the Disengage Action.

name: Wall Climber
desc: The Acynadi Delta-5 can climb most surfaces without making a Test. When it attacks or defends against a target from above, it gains Advantage.

name: Stalwart
desc: Captain Pollis has Advantage on Tests to resist or end the Frightened Condition.
candEn: The Astra Militarum Trooper has Advantage on Tests to resist or end the @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#frightened]{Frightened} Condition.
ru: Солдат получает преимущество в проверках, предпринятых, чтобы сопротивляться состоянию @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#frightened]{Страх} или прекратить его воздействие.

name: Guided Volley
desc: As an Action, Captain Pollis can target a Zone adjacent to one of her troopers and make a Challenging (+0) Presence (Leadership) Test. For each SL gained, a member of Echo Team within short range of her target Zone makes an immediate ranged attack on an enemy in that Zone.

Practised at resisting charm, intimidation, and other social pressures. Those with strong Composure are gifted at maintaining their integrity in the face of temptation.
candEn:

ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#discipline-(wil)]{Дисциплина}

Обладатели этого умения не теряют голову от чужого обаяния, не боятся угроз и давления. Никакие искушения не заставят их потерять себя.

name: People
desc:

Extensive practice in studying patterns of Human behaviour, allowing one to notice when someone is lying, hiding something, or acting strangely. This skill is often used to oppose @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.nhW5AN4gHrWvmfyz]{Rapport (Deception)}.

Понимание закономерностей человеческого поведения, что позволяет распознавать ложь, скрытность и странное поведение. Это умение часто используется против @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.nhW5AN4gHrWvmfyz]{Взаимопонимания (Обман)}.

name: Grafted Muscle
desc: Unstable, grafted muscle implants reinforce this brute's frame. At the start of their turn, a Grafted Ganger may choose to add +5 SL to any Strength or Weapon Skill Tests until the end of their turn. If they do so, they take 5 Damage at the end of their turn which is not reduced by armour.

name: Home Turf
desc: The Gang Leader has +1 Resolve and Advantage on Discipline, Presence, Navigation, and Stealth Tests if it is in its own Gang's territory
candEn: The Ganger has +1 Resolve and Advantage on Discipline Tests if it is in its own Gang's territory.
ru: Бандит получает +1 к решимости и преимущество в проверках Дисциплины, если сражается на территории своей банды.

name: Surroundings
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Training in learning to continually read the surrounding environment, noting unusual mistakes in layout, furtive steps, concealed shapes, or ominous patterns of behaviour which indicate something is wrong.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Training in learning to continually read the surrounding environment, noting unusual mistakes in layout, furtive steps, concealed shapes, or ominous patterns of behaviour which indicate something is wrong.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Чутьё}

Такая подготовка позволяет «читать» окружение, подмечать всё необычное в обстановке, обращать внимание на тихие шаги, неясные фигуры или зловещее поведение.

name: Investigation
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#logic-(int)]{Logic}

Training on how to read a crime scene for clues as to what occurred, including inferring whom the parties involved might be, as well as drawing pertinent information from any corpse present. Includes some forensic knowledge, such as knowing how to assess the angle of a strike and the sort of weapons used due to the angle of blood splatters, as well as time since the attack by studying how congealed the gore is.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#logic-(int)]{Logic}

Training on how to read a crime scene for clues as to what occurred, including inferring whom the parties involved might be, as well as drawing pertinent information from any corpse present. Includes some forensic knowledge, such as knowing how to assess the angle of a strike and the sort of weapons used due to the angle of blood splatters, as well as time since the attack by studying how congealed the gore is.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#logic-(int)]{Логика}

Умение замечать улики на месте преступления, изучать тела, выстраивать картину произошедшего и связывать её с вовлечёнными сторонами. Также включает познания в судебной экспертизе — например, умелый следователь может по брызгам крови опознать орудие убийства, направление удара и время, когда было совершено преступление.

name: Forbidden (Various)
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#lore-(int)]{Lore}

Knowledge and training in a specific subject that is utterly suppressed within the Imperium. Knowing information about aliens or psykers without specific dispensation from a powerful individual or group can get you in serious trouble. True knowledge of daemons lead to summary execution. Any knowledge of the immaterium, beyond common myth, is typically strictly obscured within the Imperium, as is real knowledge about the Adeptus Astartes. Each Forbidden Lore requires taking a corresponding @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Lbm6mRMiqSGHq9GD]{Forbidden Knowledge} Talent in order to learn it.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#lore-(int)]{Lore}

Knowledge and training in a specific subject that is utterly suppressed within the Imperium. Knowing information about aliens or psykers without specific dispensation from a powerful individual or group can get you in serious trouble. True knowledge of daemons lead to summary execution. Any knowledge of the immaterium, beyond common myth, is typically strictly obscured within the Imperium, as is real knowledge about the Adeptus Astartes. Each Forbidden Lore requires taking a corresponding @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Lbm6mRMiqSGHq9GD]{Forbidden Knowledge} Talent in order to learn it.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#lore-(int)]{Знания}

Познания в теме, которая в Империуме считается недозволенной. Обладание сведениями о чужаках и псайкерах без особого разрешения могущественного человека или группы может вызвать серьёзные проблемы. Истинные знания о демонах — уже причина для казни. Любые факты об Адептус Астартес или Имматериуме, не считая расхожих баек, также не для всех. Каждое запретное знание требует соответствующего таланта @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Lbm6mRMiqSGHq9GD]{Запретные тайны}.

name: Augmetics
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Studied in the use and repair of different types of augmetic devices. Most augmetics are mechanical or electrical augmetic substitutes for Human biological parts, many with enhanced capacities, though some offer entirely new capabilities. Augmetics requires at least 1 Advance in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Medicae} Skill.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Studied in the use and repair of different types of augmetic devices. Most augmetics are mechanical or electrical augmetic substitutes for Human biological parts, many with enhanced capacities, though some offer entirely new capabilities. Augmetics requires at least 1 Advance in the @UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Medicae} Skill.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Техника}

Умение применять и чинить разные типы имплантатов. Зачастую аугметика — это механические и электрические протезы, что заменяют части тела, иногда превосходя органические «оригиналы», а иногда открывая совершенно новые возможности. Чтобы приобрести эту специализацию, персонаж должен иметь хотя бы одно улучшение @UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Медики}.

name: Engineering
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of the construction, use, and restoration of technological and mechanical devices. Encompasses the crafting of such items, as well as weapons and explosives. Within the Imperium, the Adeptus Mechanicus considers this entire branch of knowledge to be their exclusive right and will punish those who use it, or even study it, without their sanction. Notably, an individual that knows only how to assemble or repair a device by rote need not have this Specialisation.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of the construction, use, and restoration of technological and mechanical devices. Encompasses the crafting of such items, as well as weapons and explosives. Within the Imperium, the Adeptus Mechanicus considers this entire branch of knowledge to be their exclusive right and will punish those who use it, or even study it, without their sanction. Notably, an individual that knows only how to assemble or repair a device by rote need not have this Specialisation.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Техника}

Знания о конструкции, применении и ремонте технологических и механических устройств. Эта специализация позволяет и конструировать такие предметы, а также оружие и взрывчатку. В Империуме Адептус Механикус считают эту область знания исключительно своей епархией и карают самоучек. Помните, впрочем, что для того, чтобы собрать или починить устройство, пользуясь заученными ритуалами, эта специализация не требуется.

name: People
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Extensive practice in studying patterns of Human behaviour, allowing one to notice when someone is lying, hiding something, or acting strangely. This skill is often used to oppose @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.nhW5AN4gHrWvmfyz]{Rapport (Deception)}.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Extensive practice in studying patterns of Human behaviour, allowing one to notice when someone is lying, hiding something, or acting strangely. This skill is often used to oppose @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.nhW5AN4gHrWvmfyz]{Rapport (Deception)}.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Чутьё}

Понимание закономерностей человеческого поведения, что позволяет распознавать ложь, скрытность и странное поведение. Это умение часто используется против @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.nhW5AN4gHrWvmfyz]{Взаимопонимания (Обман)}.

name: One-handed
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Бой}

Владение мечами, топорами, булавами и другим холодным оружием, что можно удерживать одной рукой.

name: Deception
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#rapport-(fel)]{Rapport}

Well-practised, or specifically trained, to deceive without flinching. Deception is often opposed by Intuition.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#rapport-(fel)]{Rapport}

Well-practised, or specifically trained, to deceive without flinching. Deception is often opposed by Intuition.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#rapport-(fel)]{Взаимопонимание}

Персонаж много практиковался врать или специально учился этому. Как правило, этому умению противостоит Чутьё.

name: Bureaucratic Boldness
desc: The character has advantage whenever dealing with paperwork, tithes, or any other bureaucratic conversation.
candEn: The Administratum Adept has a Resolve of 3 whenever dealing with paperwork, tithes, or any other bureaucratic conversation.
ru: Адепт получает решимость 3, когда дело касается бумажной работы, десятины и иных бюрократических процедур.

name: Chief Whip
desc: As an Action, the character can command any Troop of the Adeptus Administratum to immediately take an Action.
candEn: The Overseer can use Presence (Intimidation) instead of Presence (Leadership) when dealing with members of the Administratum. As an Action, the Overseer can command any Troop of the Administratum to immediately take an Action.
ru: Смотритель может использовать Командование (Запугивание) вместо Командования (Лидерство), когда имеет дело с членами Администратума. Потратив действие, смотритель может приказать рядовому члену Администратума немедленно предпринять действие.

name: Climbing
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Practised ability to safely and efficiently traverse vertical surfaces. Frequently useful on both Feral and Hive Worlds. Valuable in combat if one has to scale the side of a servo-hauler to get the drop on a heretical demagogue.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Practised ability to safely and efficiently traverse vertical surfaces. Frequently useful on both Feral and Hive Worlds. Valuable in combat if one has to scale the side of a servo-hauler to get the drop on a heretical demagogue.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Атлетика}

Атлет оттачивает умение быстро и безопасно подниматься по вертикальным поверхностям — очень полезно на диких мирах и в ульях. Это ценная способность в бою, если вам нужно взобраться на верх сервогрузовика, чтобы сбросить вниз еретического демагога.

name: Might
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Advanced capacity for moving greater weight, breaking physical objects, and enduring heavy loads. In appropriate circumstances, an Athletics (Might) Test can be used in place of a Presence (Intimidation) Test to achieve similar aims.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Advanced capacity for moving greater weight, breaking physical objects, and enduring heavy loads. In appropriate circumstances, an Athletics (Might) Test can be used in place of a Presence (Intimidation) Test to achieve similar aims.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Атлетика}

Эта специализация позволяет поднимать больший вес, ломать предметы и подолгу нести груз. В уместных обстоятельствах Атлетика (Мощь) может применяться вместо Командования (Запугивание).

name: Endurance
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Стойкость}

Умение подолгу не спать и справляться с усталостью.

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

name: Intimidation
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Applying pressure through threats, subtle or blatant, that physical chastisement and other dire fates await those that fail to do as they are told or confess all they know. Intimidation is often opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)}. If one party is of a larger @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Intimidation is often opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)}. If one party is of a larger @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Командование}

Умение применять завуалированные или недвусмысленные угрозы (физической расправой или иными ужасными карами), чтобы заставить цель сделать или рассказать что-либо. Жертва противостоит запугиванию при помощи @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Дисциплина (Самообладание)}. Если одна сторона такого разговора превосходит другую @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{размером}, то она получает преимущество в проверке.

name: Hide
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#stealth-(ag)]{Stealth}

Competence at becoming unseen or unremarked by others, such as when camouflaged amidst xenofoliage or tailing someone through a crowd. Hide is usually opposed by an observor's @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.jY2q3F8O0ogwpf6E]{Awareness (Sight)}.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#stealth-(ag)]{Stealth}

ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#stealth-(ag)]{Скрытность}

Способность оставаться невидимым или незаметным для других — прячась в ксенорастениях или смешиваясь с толпой. Обычно применяется против @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.jY2q3F8O0ogwpf6E]{Бдительности (Зрение)}.

name: Move Silently
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#stealth-(ag)]{Stealth}

Trained facility for moving soundlessly and avoiding drawing attention. Move Silently is usually opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.w8inHqYAM5sSUmg8]{Awareness (Hearing)}.
candEn:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#stealth-(ag)]{Stealth}

Trained facility for moving soundlessly and avoiding drawing attention. Move Silently is usually opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.w8inHqYAM5sSUmg8]{Awareness (Hearing)}.
ru:
@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#stealth-(ag)]{Скрытность}

Персонаж учился двигаться, не издавая шума и не привлекая внимания. Обычно применяется против @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.w8inHqYAM5sSUmg8]{Бдительности (Слух)}.

name: Unnatural Physique
desc: Harrog’s flesh and bones are unnaturally malleable, allowing her to squeeze through gaps far too small for someone her size to manage otherwise. She also gains +1 Critical Wound.

name: True Faith
desc: The Sanctifier has 1 point of Fate.
candEn: The Devout has 1 point of Fate.
ru: Праведник получает одно очко судьбы.

name: Investigation
desc:

Также включает познания в судебной экспертизе — например, умелый следователь может по брызгам крови опознать орудие убийства, направление удара и время, когда было совершено преступление.

name: Long Guns
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#ranged-(bs)]{Ranged}

Extensive training in the use of longer firearms, such as lasguns, shotguns, bolters, autoguns, meltaguns, and similar ranged weapons.

@UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#ranged-(bs)]{Стрельба}

Обширная подготовка по применению лазганов, дробовиков, болтеров, автоганов, мельт и тому подобного оружия.

name: Security
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of how to interact with the Machine Spirits that control security devices, along with whatever other systems have been linked to the same, such as doors, thermo-regulators, weapons systems, and so forth, in order to direct them in specific ways. Accomplished through the use of binary codes, modern and ancient, along with various techniques used to sift information from datavaults, secured or otherwise. A Specialisation known to few outside the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.1oKZw1hTM7Gx5cqB]{Adeptus Mechanicus}.

Мало кто за пределами @UUID[JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.1oKZw1hTM7Gx5cqB]{Адептус Механикус} владеет таким искусством.

name: Command Protocol
desc: The Skitarii Vanguard Alpha is always ready for action; their Initiative is increased by 10.

name: Rad-saturation
desc: Non-Adeptus Mechanicus characters who share a Zone with a Skitarii Vanguard Alpha become Poisoned (Minor). This effect does not stack with other instances of the Rad-saturation Trait.

name: Omnispex Augmetics
desc: Skitarii Vanguard Alpha can ignore the Dark or Poorly Lit Environmental Traits in their Zone and adjacent Zones.

name: Filtration Plugs
desc:
These items are simple to manufacture and use. They come in pairs and are each set within the nostril to eliminate noxious pollutants and harmful gases (so long as the user remembers to not breathe through their mouth).

While using filtration plugs, you gain +2 SL on Fortitude Tests made to withstand the effects of harmful gases, such as in Zones with the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#hazard]{Hazard} Trait.
candEn:
These items are simple to manufacture and use. They come in pairs and are each set within the nostril to eliminate noxious pollutants and harmful gases (so long as the user remembers to not breathe through their mouth).

While using filtration plugs, you gain +2 SL on Fortitude Tests made to withstand the effects of harmful gases, such as in Zones with the @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#hazard]{Hazard} Trait.
ru:
Это простое в производстве и применении снаряжение. Фильтры поставляются парами — ими нужно затыкать ноздри, чтобы не надышаться всевозможной отравой и вредоносными газами.

Нося фильтры-затычки, персонаж получает +2 успеха к проверкам Стойкости, предпринятым, чтобы сопротивляться воздействию опасных газов — например, в зонах со свойством @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#hazard]{Опасность}.

name: Touch of Corruption
desc: Characters affected by Sihn’s Cleanse or Seal Wounds Psychic Powers must make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude (Endurance) Test to resist gaining 1 point of Corruption.

name: Unrestrained Power
desc: Sihn can choose to gain Advantage on any Psychic Mastery Test. If he does so, he must double the Warp Charge gained.
candEn: The Rogue Psyker can choose to have Advantage on any Psychic Mastery Test. If they do so, they must double the Warp Charge gained.
ru: Нечистый псайкер может получить преимущество в любой проверке Психического мастерства, если готов удвоить полученный за это сотворение варп-заряд.

name: Burn the Witch
desc: When a non-sanctioned psyker within Medium Range of Agorax Manifests a power, Agorax may use his Reaction to make an immediate @UUID[.zwmTchhxfQXGWDzn]{Heavy Flamer} attack on the zone that psyker is in.

name: Ogryn Might
desc: Agorax has +10 to Strength and Toughness but −10 to Intelligence and Fellowship.

name: True Faith
desc: Agorax has 1 point of Fate.
candEn: The Devout has 1 point of Fate.
ru: Праведник получает одно очко судьбы.

name: Call for Backup
desc: If in earshot of Kragon’s Flask, Kragon can call for backup once per encounter. Backup usually arrives in [[/br 1d5 # Rounds]] Rounds and consists of a mix of loyal @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.ZUWBWGM4eH7xFZ8P]{Dregs} and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.bB0rMr6Gez3M9bME]{Gangers}.
candEn: As an Action, an Arbitrator can call for backup. This call is heard by all Enforcers in a 1 mile radius. Backup usually arrives in [[/r 1d10]] Rounds (or minutes if out of combat), but may be shorter or longer depending on distance.
ru: Потратив действие, арбитр может вызвать подкрепление. Его могут услышать силовики в радиусе одной мили. Обычно подкрепление прибывает через [[/r 1d10]] раундов (или минут, если сейчас не идёт бой), но это время может измениться в зависимости от расстояния.

name: Not In My House
desc: When an ally in the Flask fails a Test and can see Kragon, Kragon can use his Reaction to allow the ally to reroll the failed Test.

name: Composure
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#discipline-(wil)]{Discipline}

Practised at resisting charm, intimidation, and other social pressures. Those with strong Composure are gifted at maintaining their integrity in the face of temptation.

name: I'll Die Trying

candEn: The Astra Militarum Trooper has Advantage on Tests to resist or end the @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#frightened]{Frightened} Condition.
ru: Солдат получает преимущество в проверках, предпринятых, чтобы сопротивляться состоянию @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#frightened]{Страх} или прекратить его воздействие.

name: Trained Operator
desc: Lieutenant Cole has Advantage on Tech Tests when operating his Vox caster or any standard piece of Astra Militarum equipment.

desc: When a Beastman makes a successful attack or is wounded, he gains +1 SL on his next attack.

name: Bullish Charge
desc: When a Beastman Charges, he does not gain Disadvantage on Melee and Reflexes Tests.

name: Augmetics
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Most augmetics are mechanical or electrical augmetic substitutes for Human biological parts, many with enhanced capacities, though some offer entirely new capabilities. Augmetics requires at least 1 Advance in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Medicae} Skill.

Умение применять и чинить разные типы имплантатов. Зачастую аугметика — это механические и электрические протезы, что заменяют части тела, иногда превосходя органические «оригиналы», а иногда открывая совершенно новые возможности. Чтобы приобрести эту специализацию, персонаж должен иметь хотя бы одно улучшение @UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Медики}.

name: Engineering
desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of the construction, use, and restoration of technological and mechanical devices. Encompasses the crafting of such items, as well as weapons and explosives. Within the Imperium, the Adeptus Mechanicus considers this entire branch of knowledge to be their exclusive right and will punish those who use it, or even study it, without their sanction. Notably, an individual that knows only how to assemble or repair a device by rote need not have this Specialisation.

Знания о конструкции, применении и ремонте технологических и механических устройств. Эта специализация позволяет и конструировать такие предметы, а также оружие и взрывчатку. В Империуме Адептус Механикус считают эту область знания исключительно своей епархией и карают самоучек. Помните, впрочем, что для того, чтобы собрать или починить устройство, пользуясь заученными ритуалами, эта специализация не требуется.

name: Augmetic Heart
desc: As an Action, the Tech-Priest makes a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test. If they are successful, they remove a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#bleeding]{Bleeding} Condition from themself.
candEn: As an Action, the Tech-Priest makes a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test. If they are successful, they remove a @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#bleeding]{Bleeding} Condition from themself.
ru: Потратив действие, техножрец проходит среднюю (+0) проверку Стойкости. В случае успеха он снимает с себя состояние @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#bleeding]{Кровотечение}.

name: Utility Mechadendrite
desc: Functions as a Combi-tool and a melee weapon.
ru: Служит комбиинструментом и холодным оружием.

name: Utility Mechadendrite
desc:
These snake-like metal devices are affixed to the chest, back, or shoulders and act as additional manipulators. They are only found among adepts of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.1oKZw1hTM7Gx5cqB]{Adeptus Mechanicus}, and extend roughly 2 metres in length. Each is fitted with its own special mechanisms. Using any Mechadendrite requires an Action.

Each Mechadendrite counts as a separate augmentation towards the maximum number a character can possess. If a character with Mechadendrites would suffer a Critical Wound to the Body location, roll a d10. If the result is less than the number of functioning Mechadendrites the character has installed, one of those is damaged instead. Damaged Mechadendrites cannot be used until they are repaired.

  • Utility: These are fitted with several devices for repairing and renovating machines, and are the most common form of Mechadendrite. They count as a Standard Quality @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.xQ2vhqZTWMBZ3Jxi]{Combi-Tool}, granting +2 SL to Tech Tests, and can be used in melee combat as an @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.CrbE669FitnwNPZX]{Improvised Melee Weapon (One-handed)}.
candEn:
These snake-like metal devices are affixed to the chest, back, or shoulders and act as additional manipulators. They are only found among adepts of the @UUID[JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.1oKZw1hTM7Gx5cqB]{Adeptus Mechanicus}, and extend roughly 2 metres in length. Each is fitted with its own special mechanisms. Using any Mechadendrite requires an Action.

Each Mechadendrite counts as a separate augmentation towards the maximum number a character can possess. If a character with Mechadendrites would suffer a Critical Wound to the Body location, roll a d10. If the result is less than the number of functioning Mechadendrites the character has installed, one of those is damaged instead. Damaged Mechadendrites cannot be used until they are repaired.

  • Utility: These are fitted with several devices for repairing and renovating machines, and are the most common form of Mechadendrite. They count as a Standard Quality @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.xQ2vhqZTWMBZ3Jxi]{Combi-Tool}, granting +2 SL to Tech Tests, and can be used in melee combat as an @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.CrbE669FitnwNPZX]{Improvised Melee Weapon (One-handed)}.
ru:
Эти змееподобные, почти двухметровые металлические «руки» крепятся на груди, спине или плечах хозяина и служат ему дополнительными конечностями. Каждый оснащён специальными приспособлениями и при подсчёте предельного количества имплантатов, что может поставить себе персонаж, считается отдельной единицей аугметики. Механодендриты встречаются только у членов Адептус Механикус.

Применение механодендрита требует действия. Если персонаж, имеющий механодендриты, получает критическую рану в торс, бросьте 1к10. Если выпадет число, меньшее количества установленных и работающих механодендритов, значит попадание повреждает механодендрит. Повреждённый механодендрит не будет работать, пока его не починят.

Это самый расхожий тип механодендрита — он оснащён инструментами для работы с машинами и считается комбиинструментом среднего качества, но приносит +2 успеха к проверкам Техники, а также может использоваться в ближнем бою как импровизированное одноручное оружие.

name: Data Delver
desc: The Administratum Adept has Advantage on Tests made to find or retrieve information from a document or archive (whether analog or digital).
candEn:
You are naturally in tune with the flow of data and recorded information, effortlessly able to navigate the often byzantine records of the Imperium. You have Advantage on Tests made to find or retrieve information from a document or archive (whether analog or digital). Additionally, you read text in half the time it would normally take.

If you take this Talent again, you have Advantage on any Test made to determine where, when, how, or by whom a piece of information was created.
ru:
Вы от природы хорошо умеете работать с потоками данных и без труда ориентируетесь в запутанных имперских архивах. Вы получаете преимущество в проверках, призванных найти сведения в документе или извлечь их из архива (неважно, бумажного или цифрового). Кроме того, вы читаете вдвое быстрее обычного.

Если вы приобретёте этот талант ещё раз, то будете получать преимущество на все проверки, предпринятые, чтобы определить, где, кем, как и когда была создана изучаемая информация.
